clarification.explanation: The 63-character typo is itself inside the v2 preregistration bytes, so the earlier field name execution_input_or_wrapper_hash_affected was imprecise. Those exact preregistration bytes and their SHA-256 were consistently frozen, staged, and checked by the wrapper. The typo changed neither runtime code/configuration/checkpoint identity nor the wrapper check outcome; it only made the transitive v1 launch-manifest pointer incorrect.
